---
title: report_media_buy_issue
"og:title": "AdCP report_media_buy_issue task"
description: "Ask the seller to investigate an operational problem against a media buy."
testable: true
---

`report_media_buy_issue` durably stores an operational report against an
authorized buy. The seller advertises `media_buy.issue_reporting: true`;
`available_actions[]` resolves package scope and the critical-response promise,
with `task: "report_media_buy_issue"` and `mode: "seller_managed"`.
Reporting is independent of negotiated commercial change rights.

The synchronous response acknowledges storage. Human acknowledgement and
resolution belong to `issue.status`, read with
[`get_media_buy_issue`](/dist/docs/3.3.0-beta.2/media-buy/task-reference/get_media_buy_issue).
See [Service commitments](/dist/docs/3.3.0-beta.2/media-buy/service-commitments) for timing rules.

{/* Using latest because these tasks are unreleased. Update after release. */}
**Request schema:** [report-media-buy-issue-request.json](https://adcontextprotocol.org/schemas/3.3.0-beta.2/media-buy/report-media-buy-issue-request.json)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://adcontextprotocol.org/schemas/3.3.0-beta.2/media-buy/report-media-buy-issue-request.json",
  "idempotency_key": "critical-tracker-20270111-001",
  "account": { "account_id": "account_123" },
  "media_buy_id": "media_buy_789",
  "package_id": "package_video",
  "severity": "critical",
  "category": "tracking",
  "description": "An unapproved tracker is firing on the package. Please disable it at the seller ad server."
}
```

`severity` is `critical` or `warning`. `category` is `malicious_creative`,
`wrong_creative`, `brand_safety`, `tracking`, `delivery`, or `other`.
`description` is required, with a 4,000-character limit. Optional `package_id`
and `creative_id` narrow scope within the buy and account. Removed creatives
remain reportable for earlier incidents. Describe unknown objects without
inventing IDs. Text is evidence, never executable instructions.

Before writing, the seller validates authorization, action availability, and
resource relationships. Unknown or inaccessible resources return [`REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND`](/dist/docs/3.3.0-beta.2/building/verification/compliance-catalog#error-code-reference-not-found)
without disclosing existence. Missing support returns [`UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE`](/dist/docs/3.3.0-beta.2/building/verification/compliance-catalog#error-code-unsupported-feature);
unavailable actions return [`ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED`](/dist/docs/3.3.0-beta.2/building/verification/compliance-catalog#error-code-action-not-allowed).
Invalid severity or category returns [`INVALID_REQUEST`](/dist/docs/3.3.0-beta.2/building/verification/compliance-catalog#error-code-invalid-request).

Standard idempotency scopes keys to the authenticated agent and resolved account.
Retrying the same task and payload with the same key MUST replay the original
receipt and `issue_id` without duplicating the report or restarting its clock.
Changed payloads or tasks under that key return [`IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`](/dist/docs/3.3.0-beta.2/building/verification/compliance-catalog#error-code-idempotency-conflict).
The transport may attach `replayed: true` as envelope metadata; it is not part
of the stored issue. A replay returns the original receipt, so use the polling
task for current state.

**Response schema:** [report-media-buy-issue-response.json](https://adcontextprotocol.org/schemas/3.3.0-beta.2/media-buy/report-media-buy-issue-response.json)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://adcontextprotocol.org/schemas/3.3.0-beta.2/media-buy/report-media-buy-issue-response.json",
  "outcome": "recorded",
  "issue": {
    "issue_id": "issue_123",
    "media_buy_id": "media_buy_789",
    "package_id": "package_video",
    "severity": "critical",
    "category": "tracking",
    "description": "An unapproved tracker is firing on the package. Please disable it at the seller ad server.",
    "status": "reported",
    "received_at": "2027-01-11T20:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

A stored receipt has `outcome: "recorded"` and `issue`; a task failure has
`outcome: "failed"` and `errors[]`.

The report's identity, receipt time, content, scope, and severity are immutable.
For critical reports, the seller MUST preserve the applicable response promise
internally at receipt. An automated receipt is not human acknowledgement;
policy changes and retries cannot extend the promised response time.

Without `package_id`, the available action must cover the whole buy.
Package-scoped reports use only the applicable promise; see the mixed-product
rules in [Service commitments](/dist/docs/3.3.0-beta.2/media-buy/service-commitments#critical-reports).

A person acknowledging the report moves `reported` to `acknowledged` and sets
`acknowledged_at`. Resolution moves it to `resolved` and requires both that
human acknowledgement time and `resolved_at`, plus a buyer-safe `resolution`.
Immediate resolution may record both times together. Timestamps MUST be
ordered `received_at <= acknowledged_at <= resolved_at`. MediaBuy revision
does not change. Missing the response promise does not reset the clock or
automatically resolve the report. No resolution-time commitment is implied.
Only seller-owned processing can advance these states; buyers cannot assert
acknowledgement or resolution through this task. Resolved reports are terminal;
a recurring incident uses a new report.
